visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The scene begins in a brightly lit office or workshop setting. A pair of hands is shown unboxing a brown cardboard box with a black 'CAMPFIRE' logo. Various other boxes are visible in the background. (2) The hands lift out a large, square stainless steel lid or tray wrapped in plastic. A white manual with the brand logo is also presented. (3) The scene transitions to a close-up of a square stainless steel pot being removed from the box. The internal volume markings are clearly visible on the side. The person flips the pot to show the induction-compatible icons on the bottom. (4) A smaller box is opened to reveal black and silver handles. The hands demonstrate how to disassemble the silicone grip from the metal handle and then show the assembly process for the pot handles, involving a rotating lock mechanism. (5) The various components (pot, pan, handles, lids) are laid out. Finally, a middle-aged male with short hair and a green jacket holds up the finished product, smiling broadly at the camera in a medium close-up shot.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio begins with an upbeat, medium-tempo pop-electronic track featuring a female English vocal snippet. A male narrator begins speaking in Traditional Chinese with a friendly, energetic tone. (2) As the lid is lifted, a sharp, metallic clinking sound (Metal Bump) is audible, followed by the soft rustling of plastic wrapping. (3) A distinct paper flipping sound occurs as the manual is shown. The narrator continues explaining the product details with consistent pace and moderate volume. (4) When the pot is moved, a resonant metallic scraping sound is heard against the table. (5) As the handles are unboxed and manipulated, there are clear mechanical clicks and plastic rustling noises. The music remains steady in the background. (6) A final metallic latching sound occurs when the handle is locked onto the pot. The male voice concludes with an appreciative tone as the music swells slightly before fading out.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: List-based: Hook -> Component Inventory -> Quality Close-ups -> Assembly Demo -> Host Presentation
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video serves as a detailed unboxing and instructional demonstration for the CAMPFIRE camping cookware set. It aims to showcase the build quality, induction compatibility, and the specialized handle assembly mechanism to reassure and inform customers who have pre-ordered the product.
